sentences.text: The AI photo read of Nyx's May 23 vomit noted a possible plastic fragment, which is unconfirmed and cannot be checked as the photo was not retained, and she vomited on 4 of the 7 days to Jun 30.
Vomiting has run for at least 47 days, with 23 entries on 23 of 43 logged days from May 14 to Jun 30; May 14 is her first entry of any kind, so onset is unknown.
Of the 23 entries, 18 legible of 23 have an AI read, unconfirmed: undigested food 12 to Jun 6, then bile or foam 5 from Jun 9 to 18 and hairball 1 on Jun 21, with 5 unread.
She is free-fed Nature's Variety Duck and Royal Canin Weight Care all day, so intake not directly observed, and no food could be isolated: chicken is in her all-day kibble.
Weight, body condition, medication, medical conditions and neuter status are not recorded.
